text:
elaine: Heads up — support escalated ticket INC-2026: customer reports p99 up ~3x after runtime v1.18 rollout to canary cohort. Seeing auth refresh latency and cold KV hits. Putting notes here.
nathan: Link to ticket? Which cohort/tenants affected?
elaine: INC: https://redwood.support/INC-2026. Affected tenants: cohort 'beta-3' ~2% traffic. p95 stable, p99 spikes. Spike started ~2026-03-16 22:41 UTC right after canary flip.
jun: Quick telemetry: traces show increased tail in auth-fetch span (sync permfetch), and KV cache miss rate jumped from 7%->46% on canary nodes.
sam: Any kernel selector or quant bump merged in that rollout?
nathan: Yes — variant 'runtime-1.18-kernel-v2' + default kv-ttl reduced to 30s in canary. Also auth client changed to synchronous refresh when 401.
maya: That's our smoking gun. Synchronous auth refresh on tail + cold KV TTL would amplify p99.
support-bot: Auto-alert: Canary p99 delta >2.5x threshold. Canary flag: runtime-1.18 deployed to 2% of traffic across cluster-a.
jun: Repro steps I'm running: replaying cohort traffic against canary image with kv warmers disabled. Command:

```
./replay --cohort beta-3 --image runtime-1.18 --warm-kv=false --qps 200
```
sam: Results?
jun: p99 aligns with customer: 1.8s -> 5.2s when auth-refresh happens concurrently. Stack shows auth client waiting on permfetch HTTP call blocking request processing thread.
nathan: Mitigations: 1) revert sync auth-refresh to async w/ circuit 2) restore kv-ttl to 5m for canary 3) temporarily divert cohort traffic to previous runtime. Which we can do quickly?
elaine: @nathan @sam please coordinate rollback of auth change and bump kv-ttl on canary. I'm opening a rollback ticket and contacting CSM.
sam: I'll push a hotpatch to revert auth sync in canary—should be small. ETA 15m. Also toggling kv-ttl param via config. Will post deploy id.
sam: hotpatch deployed -> 3344556780. KV-ttl set to 300s for canary. Monitoring...
oncall-bot: Deploybot: runtime-1.18-hotfix-3344556780 deployed to canary (2% traffic).
jun: Early telemetry: KV miss rate dropped to 9% and p99 back to ~1.9s. Still slightly elevated vs baseline 1.75s — likely noise.
elaine: Customer informed. CSM confirms decreased errors. Will schedule followup to discuss permanent rollback vs config change.
nathan: Follow-ups: run controlled bisect to confirm root cause between kernel-v2 vs auth-change vs kv-ttl. Plan: A/B variants: (A) kernel-v2 + old auth async + old kv-ttl, (B) kernel-v1 + new auth + old kv-ttl, (C) kernel-v2 + new auth + 5m kv-ttl. Replay each.
maya: I'll own the bisect replay and post results. Also we should add a histogram of auth-refresh latencies to runtime dashboards.
elaine: :thumbsup: Thanks team. Logging the postmortem and steps. Closing interim escalation.
